svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.35k stars in total, about 1.08k a year earlier, mostly from tools launched since then. mr boxington 478, aube 2028, fnox 2241, hk 1248, pitchfork 677, usage 1055, +6 more 622.
